conditions.environment: Disposable local Docker Compose project; loopback HTTP/HTTPS only.
conditions.postgresql: PostgreSQL 17, internal-only database network, persistent named volume, verified private CA and certificate hostname.
conditions.https: Caddy local CA; Node HTTPS verifies chain and localhost identity. No certificate bypass used.
conditions.appRuntime: UID 1000, read-only root filesystem, writable temporary directory.
conditions.buildTrust: Platform CA mounted through BuildKit only for npm installs, with TLS verification enabled.

browserHttps.reason: Existing shared legacy NSS database prevents isolated CA selection. Shared trust was preserved and HTTPS verification was not disabled. Browser UI checks are separate from this local TLS test.

limits: Local runtime validation only; no public DNS, public certificate, real VPS deployment, coexistence validation, or capacity benchmark.
